exit 0
--- stdout
Capture a command before native truncation or streaming
Usage:
liza tool-result run [flags] -- EXECUTABLE [ARGS...]
Flags:
--agent-id string Agent identifier
--command string Original command identity
--command-class string Command class
-h, --help help for run
--role string Agent role
--session-id string Session identifier
--task-id string Task identifier
--tool string Tool name (default "exec")
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
--digest-bytes int Maximum externalized result digest bytes (default 4096)
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--root string Artifact directory (default: project state directory/tool-results)
--threshold-bytes int Externalize results larger than this many bytes (default 32768)
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
